<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 19:20">Targ. Y. Lev. XIX, 20</cite> <cite ref="U00768"><he>שְׁטַר</he></cite> (constr.); a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 17b:1">B. Mets. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>כמאן דנקיט ש׳ בידיה</he> as valid as if he held a bond in his hand; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Pesachim 78a:14">Pes. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>ור׳ יוסי ש׳ מזכי … הוא</he> is R. Jose a bond in favor of both parties?, i.e. does he not adopt two opinions contradictory to each other in principle?.—Pl. <he>שְׁטָרֵי</he>, <he>שְׁטָרָאֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 85a:18">Keth. 85ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 151a:1">B. Bath. 151ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M01496"><he>מְלוֹגָא</he></cite>.
